title: The finished artwork
copy: Blue tones connect the product with the sky, expressing an ambition for premium audio quality.

title: A skyward direction
copy: A blue gradient establishes the sky-inspired palette. The curtain-like rhythm on the left adds a sense of enclosure.

title: The product comes forward
copy: The headphones are the central subject. This limited-angle study retains the original silhouette; it is not a complete 3D model.

title: Glass, light and sound
copy: The glass display combines the audio interface with reflections and shadows created in Photoshop.

title: Weight and handwriting
copy: The owner identifies The Bolt Font for the bold JBL lettering and Amsterdam Handwriting for the handwritten Premium contrast.

title: One composition again
copy: The individual decisions return to the original artwork. The final image is the untouched portfolio original.
